metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shares a 3-step method for those seeking alternatives to back surgery.

If you've consulted with a surgeon and been advised that physical therapy or chiropractic care could help avoid surgery, this video is for you.

We’ll walk you through 3 steps designed to promote healing and strengthen your back.

Be sure to follow all the steps and focus on what works best for you.
